description:
Returns a paginated list of the invoices of this company, filterable by status, type,
series, customer, date range and free text. Only the documents of the company in the path
are returned.

BeeL API endpoint: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

⚠️ Read before calling:
- Fiscal rules, domains lifecycle: beel_rules_list with domain, or resource beel://guardrails/<domain>.
- The status names, the proforma lifecycle, and which tool performs each operation. (resource: beel://guardrails/invoice-state-machine)

InvoiceStatus.description:
- SCHEDULED: Scheduled invoice to be issued automatically on a future date
- DRAFT: Draft invoice not sent yet (modifiable)
- ISSUED: Finalized invoice with definitive number but not sent
- SENT: Invoice sent to customer
- PAID: Invoice paid
- OVERDUE: Unpaid invoice in `ISSUED` or `SENT` status, with a total above zero, whose `due_date` is
  earlier than the current day in Europe/Madrid. A periodic process sets it, so it can lag behind
  the due date. It changes to `PAID` when the invoice is paid.
- RECTIFIED: Partially corrected invoice (one or more PARTIAL corrective invoices)
- VOIDED: Cancelled invoice. Reached either through a direct void request or
  through a TOTAL corrective invoice; `void_cause` tells the two apart.
- CONVERTED: Proforma converted into an invoice (terminal; the proforma survives
  as the record of the accepted quote, linked to the created invoice)
- ACTIVE: Active proforma. The single working state of a proforma (non-fiscal
  document): born numbered (PRO-...) and editable, never reaching the fiscal
  statuses. It transitions to CONVERTED when turned into an invoice, or to VOIDED
  when the offer is rejected/withdrawn (POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/void).
- EXPIRED: Proforma whose offer validity (`valid_until`) has passed. Derived on read
  and never stored; the proforma stays convertible and editable.

InvoiceType.description:
- STANDARD: Standard invoice
- CORRECTIVE: Corrects or cancels a previous invoice
- SIMPLIFIED: Simplified invoice (ticket), for a recipient that is not identified. BeeL.
  requires a STANDARD invoice when the recipient is identified, at any amount: a
  SIMPLIFIED invoice whose recipient carries an `nif` or `alternative_id` is rejected
  with `SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_FORBIDS_IDENTIFIED_RECIPIENT`. The only amount BeeL
  enforces is a cap of 3,000€ VAT included (`SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_EXCEEDS_LEGAL_LIMIT`). The
  general limit of RD 1619/2012 is 400€ (art. 4.1.a); up to 3,000€ applies only to the
  activities listed in art. 4.2. BeeL does not check which activity the issuer carries
  out.
- PROFORMA: Commercial document (formal quote) with no fiscal validity.
  Never enters VeriFactu (no QR, no AEAT submission): `verifactu.enabled` is
  always `false`, whatever the company's regime. Requires full recipient data,
  like STANDARD.
  Cannot be corrective nor reference a rectified invoice.

PaymentMethod.description:
Payment method shown on invoices and recurring invoices.

- `NONE`: no payment information is shown.
- `BANK_TRANSFER`: bank transfer to the IBAN of the payment details; the only method
  that requires an IBAN.
- `CARD`: card payment.
- `CASH`: cash payment.
- `CHECK`: payment by cheque.
- `DIRECT_DEBIT`: direct debit from the customer's bank account.
- `BIZUM`: payment through Bizum.
- `OTHER`: any other method.

SortOrder.description:
Sort direction. Shared vocabulary for every `sort_order` query param: declared once so the
generator emits a real enum and an unknown direction is rejected with `400` instead of being
silently ignored.

VeriFactuSubmissionStatus.description:
Submission status of an invoice's VeriFactu record to AEAT.

Single vocabulary for the whole axis: the same values are published in
`verifactu.submission_status` of an invoice and accepted by the `verifactu_status`
filter of `GET /v1/invoices`, so a value read from an invoice can be fed straight
back into the filter. `ACCEPTED` does not include the records accepted with errors, which
have their own value. New values may be added over time: treat any value you do not
recognise as an unknown status.

* `PENDING` — queued, AEAT has not answered yet. A temporary AEAT server error also
  stays `PENDING`: BeeL. retries it automatically, and it only becomes `REJECTED` if the
  retries run out. So does a submission that failed because of a technical problem on
  BeeL.'s side: BeeL. submits it again once the problem is fixed. Do not void it or issue
  another invoice for it.
* `ACCEPTED` — accepted by AEAT without remarks.
* `ACCEPTED_WITH_ERRORS` — accepted by AEAT, which also reported errors in the record
  (see `error_code` / `error_message`). The record stands, but the data AEAT flagged
  must be reviewed. Do not treat it as a clean `ACCEPTED`.
* `VOIDED` — a cancellation record was accepted by AEAT.
* `REJECTED` — rejected by AEAT, or the submission was rejected by the provider
  before reaching AEAT (see `error_code` / `error_message`).
* `NOT_SUBMITTED` — the invoice is issued with VeriFactu enabled but has no live
  record: the submission fell through (lost event, exhausted retries) and AEAT
  does not know the invoice exists. Transient right after issuing (the async
  submission may still be in flight); if it persists, the registration needs to
  be re-driven.

Drafts and scheduled invoices have no submission to describe yet and omit the
field. Invoices with `verifactu.enabled = false` are outside this axis and are
selected with the `verifactu_enabled` filter.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

custom_fields.description:
Filter by the custom fields saved on the invoice, written as `custom_fields[<key>]=<value>`.
The value is compared with the text stored on the invoice, exactly (case and accents
included); several keys are combined with AND, and with the other filters. Max 20 keys
per request. A key the company does not have matches no invoice.
Example: `?custom_fields[project]=North&custom_fields[cost_centre]=CC-12`

date_from.description:
Date from, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). It applies to the operation date when set, and to the
issue date otherwise.

date_to.description: Date to, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Applies to the same date as `date_from`.

due_date_from.description: Due date from, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Invoices without a due date are excluded.

due_date_to.description: Due date to, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Invoices without a due date are excluded.

external_ref.description: Filter by exact external reference (client-supplied order/cart/contract id).

fiscal_only.description:
When `true` (the default), returns only fiscal documents (STANDARD, CORRECTIVE,
SIMPLIFIED), excluding proformas and any other non-fiscal document. Set it to `false`
to list every document type. Ignored when an explicit `type` is given: use
`type=PROFORMA` to list proformas.

limit.description: How many items to return per page. The response echoes it back as `pagination.items_per_page`.

metadata.description:
Filter by metadata key/value pairs (exact match, AND between keys).
Repeat the bracket-style param to filter on multiple keys.
Max 50 pairs per request. Keys must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_\-.]{1,64}$`.
Example: `?metadata[external_order_id]=ORD-42&metadata[tenant]=acme`
To filter by a custom field, use `custom_fields[<key>]`.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The response echoes it back as `pagination.current_page`.

payment_date_from.description: Payment date from, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Invoices without a payment date are excluded.

payment_date_to.description: Payment date to, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Invoices without a payment date are excluded.

payment_method.description:
Filter by payment method. Accepts a comma-separated list to match any of several
methods, for example `payment_method=DIRECT_DEBIT,CARD`. A single value is also valid.
`NONE` also matches invoices that have no payment method stored. Combine it with
`date_from`/`date_to` to list, for example, the direct debits of a month. An empty
value (`payment_method=`) is the same as omitting the parameter.

pending_collection_only.description:
When `true`, returns only the invoices pending collection: STANDARD, SIMPLIFIED or
CORRECTIVE invoices in status ISSUED, SENT, OVERDUE or RECTIFIED with no payment recorded
(no `payment_date`). A CORRECTIVE invoice whose original invoice is `VOIDED` with no
`payment_date` is left out: nothing is owed and nothing has to be refunded for that
pair. One whose original has a `payment_date` is included. It combines with the other
filters, so a `status` or `type` outside that set returns an empty list. `false`, the
default, does not filter.

recipient_name.description: Filter by recipient's fiscal name (partial, case-insensitive search)

rectified_invoice_id.description:
Return the corrective invoices that correct this invoice. Accepts the id of an
issued invoice; a single invoice can have several partial correctives.

replaced_by_invoice_id.description:
Return the simplified invoices replaced by this exchange invoice. Accepts the id of an
issued full invoice; it matches the ids in its `replaced_invoice_ids`.

search.description: Global search across invoice number, recipient name, recipient NIF, and series code (partial, case-insensitive)

series_code.description: Filter by series code (exact match, case-insensitive). Use `search` for partial matching across the invoice number, recipient and series code.

sort_by.description:
Field to sort by: `issue_date` (default), `operation_date`, `due_date`,
`invoice_number`, `series_code`, `status`, `invoice_total`, `taxable_base`,
`total_vat`, `total_equivalence_surcharge`, `total_discounts`, `recipient_name`,
`recipient_nif`, `created_at` or `updated_at`. Any other value is rejected with `400`
`VALIDATION_ERROR`, whose `details` name `sort_by` and the accepted values.
`invoice_number` sorts by series code and then by the number within the series,
compared numerically (`F-9` before `F-10`). Ties on any field are broken by series
code, then by the number within the series and then by id, in the requested direction.

status.description:
Filter by invoice status. Accepts a comma-separated list to match any of several
statuses, for example `status=DRAFT,ISSUED`. A single value is also valid. An empty
value (`status=`) is the same as omitting the parameter.

verifactu_enabled.description:
Filter by whether VeriFactu is enabled for the invoice — the same flag published as
`verifactu.enabled`. `false` returns the invoices that never reach AEAT.

verifactu_status.description:
Filter by the VeriFactu submission status of the invoice, using the very same
vocabulary that `verifactu.submission_status` publishes on each invoice.
`NOT_SUBMITTED` selects issued invoices with VeriFactu enabled whose
registration never happened (no live record).

name: beel_list_invoices
